providers.name: GPT-6 Luna / Max
providers.description: Use for routine bounded inspection, documentation and implementation with explicit inputs and clear checks. Suitable for ordinary repository scanning and evidence-based audits; a read-only task does not require a stronger model.

providers.name: GPT-6.1 Sol / High
providers.description: Use for complex implementation, cross-module repository analysis and independent review. Select when the work needs difficult integration or a fresh critical judgment beyond routine bounded inspection.

providers.name: GPT-6 Astra / Medium
providers.description: Use only for difficult planning, novel causal diagnosis and unresolved design tradeoffs. Ordinary scanning, documentation, checklist audits and straightforward route decisions do not justify this model. Main conversation decisions belong to Main orchestration.

providers.name: Built-in Cursor CDP connector
providers.description: Repository-owned Cursor connector using loopback CDP and one supported Agents UI profile. Requires desktop live smoke on the user machine.

providers.name: Built-in Grok ACP connector
providers.description: Repository-owned Grok connector using a dedicated Leader and ACP over stdio for read-only and policy-bounded write work. Requires desktop live smoke.

providers.name: ChatGPT web Pro packet reviewer
providers.description: Optional ZIP Packet reviewer via the chatgpt-agent packet.inspect route for genuine planning dead ends or high-blast-radius uncertainty. The model and thinking level are selected only in the ChatGPT web session. Advisory only.

providers.name: Custom OpenAI-compatible advisory model
providers.description: Optional text-only custom model. Replace endpoint/model and set the named environment variable before enabling.

config.system_prompt: You are an advisory subagent. Return evidence-based analysis only. Do not claim file access, tool execution, or implementation.
